test_merge_caption_basic: test TelegramAdapter._merge_caption with no existing text and new text returns the new text
test_merge_caption_duplicate: test TelegramAdapter._merge_caption drops exact duplicate captions and returns single caption
test_merge_caption_merge_unique: test TelegramAdapter._merge_caption merges two different captions separated by double newline
test_merge_caption_substring: test TelegramAdapter._merge_caption does not drop shorter caption when it is a substring of existing text
test_merge_caption_whitespace: test TelegramAdapter._merge_caption treats trailing and leading spaces as duplicates
